S01.hero_product: Premium Wild Caught New Zealand Abalone 425g
S01.story: New Moon lists its Premium Wild Caught New Zealand Abalone at 425 g, with abalone, water, salt and sugar among its ingredients. The New Zealand origin gives this seafood favourite a clear sense of place.
S01.shop_theme: Dark timber shelving, brushed brass trim and soft pearl lighting.

S02.story: MILI’s Vegetarian Oyster Sauce comes in a 510 g bottle, with mushroom extract among its ingredients. Its pantry-friendly flavour has a place beside everyday meals, ready to add a savoury touch to home cooking.
S02.shop_theme: Warm wood, matte green panels and cream ceramic details.

S03.hero_product: canned drinks and potong ice cream
S03.story: GOGO’s category covers drinks and ice cream, including canned drinks and potong ice cream. Cool drinks and a familiar frozen treat bring a cheerful, everyday note to the pantry and freezer.
S03.shop_theme: Bright tiled surfaces, rounded display forms and a cool counter glow.

S04.story: Borsch Med’s mosquito repellent patches come in an 18-patch pack and list citronella oil among the ingredients. The pack’s directions describe placing a patch on clothing or a nearby surface, a useful everyday detail.
S04.shop_theme: Calm sage shelving, plum accents and a softly lit personal-care counter.

S05.story: Pien Tze Huang is a medicine named on the official company site, which describes one troche per box. The name and single-item format give this traditional medicine category a concise, familiar character.
S05.shop_theme: Parchment-toned shelving, dark timber and restrained red accents.

S06.story: Flying Wheel’s Singapore ban mee noodles are air-dried and listed at 70 g, with wheat flour, water and sea salt among the ingredients. A simple noodle staple brings a little warmth to the everyday pantry.
S06.shop_theme: Light timber shelves, woven textures and a slate-blue sign band.

S07.story: Gu Long’s Pork Leg Mushroom listing is 397 g and names pork leg, mushrooms and Chinese chestnut among the ingredients. Its wider range includes stewed pork, luncheon meat, seafood, fruit and vegetables, a generous mix of pantry choices.
S07.shop_theme: Deep timber, jade-green shelf edges and warm red signage.

S08.story: SKIPPY Creamy Peanut Butter is listed at 500 g, with roasted peanuts, sugar, peanut oil, vegetable oil and salt among its ingredients. A familiar jar and a steady pantry staple for everyday meals.
S08.shop_theme: Blue enamel shelving, pale timber and a warm cream counter.

S09.story: SPAM Classic Luncheon Meat is listed at 340 g, with pork and ham among its ingredients. Classic is one variety in the SPAM range, offering a familiar canned pantry staple for simple meals and shared tables.
S09.shop_theme: Navy sign panels, pale metal trim and a warm yellow light strip.

S10.story: GJH’s abalone category lists Red California Mexico Abalone at 454 g; California Mexico Products is named among its distributed brands. A simple seafood note brings a little warmth to the pantry.
S10.shop_theme: Cool teal shelving, red sign accents and pearl-toned display surfaces.

S11.hero_product: (no product found; use generic canned-food shelf)
S11.story: A canned-food shelf belongs in an everyday kitchen, ready for a variety of simple meals. This familiar pantry category brings a sense of order and choice without pointing to one particular food.
S11.shop_theme: Neutral pantry shelving with berry-red signage and simple metal details.

S12.story: Zeria Chondro Support is listed as a 150-tablet product in GJH’s Joint Health category; Zeria’s official catalogue also lists Chondro Support. The name and tablet format suit a neat, considered place in the cabinet.
S12.shop_theme: Cool white shelving, indigo panels and muted teal accents.

S13.story: Sony’s MDR-E9LP are white wired in-ear headphones, listed in GJH’s brand directory. A compact pair for everyday listening, with the model number and white colour to set it apart.
S13.shop_theme: Charcoal slatted panels, brushed silver trim and soft acoustic lighting.

S14.story: LG’s UR75 is a 43-inch 4K Smart UHD television, and LG appears in GJH’s brand directory. The 43-inch screen brings generous scale to home viewing, with its resolution and category easy to recognize.
S14.shop_theme: Smooth white walls, silver display rails and violet sign panels.

S15.tagline: Keys and sound, side by side
S15.story: Casio’s GP-510BP belongs to the CELVIANO Grand Hybrid line and is a digital piano; Casio appears in GJH’s directory. The broad keyboard and piano form bring a quiet music-room feeling.
S15.shop_theme: Dark walnut display floor, black panels and warm gallery spotlights.

S16.story: The white GP eTag is listed with a lanyard hole and built-in buzzer; GP describes eTag as a smart tracker. Its small round form and opening give it an easy, familiar shape.
S16.shop_theme: White modular shelving, teal edging and a restrained lime marker.

S17.tagline: A handset with a home base
S17.story: Gigaset’s A270 is a cordless phone with a white colour option; versions are described with or without an answering machine. A handset and base remain a familiar part of the home telephone landscape.
S17.shop_theme: Graphite sign band, satin silver details and white display plinths.
